description:
In a fantasy world where mystical powers are harnessed through magical gems known as "Loo," Nino is a total outlier. Despite being a low-ranking member of a bandit crew, he has never been able to manifest a single ability, no matter which gem he touches. 

His luck takes an unexpected turn during a routine mission when he stumbles upon a peculiar lamp. But this is no ordinary relic: it is the legendary lamp of Genie, the magical spirit of wishes. Will this chance encounter finally grant Nino the power he's been denied, or lead him into even greater trouble?
